waiting_on_trader.meaning: Push master: 2 commits ahead of origin (the testnet experiment results; the temporary test switches were added and removed).
Before any live use: confirm Deribit's 'cancel on disconnect' is OFF on the live account and key (it was ON on testnet and deleted every stop on each disconnect; now off there).

Decide whether to run risk sizing in Live. ⚠ The adversarial audit's partial-fill finding blocks it: risk sizing produces 80-90 USD entries, and a partial fill can flip the account short with no stop. Hold until that is fixed or a 10-USD live cap is in force.
AWS London migration. The key choreography removes the window where two executors run at once.

next_up.what: Batch-2 spec with the new evidence, now including the testnet experiment results (the exchange pushes the dead stop leg as rejected; the stop never trails; a reduce-only take-profit cancels both legs): live no-stop watchdog, dead stop-leg alert, stop distance checked against the fill, cancel-on-disconnect check at connect, manual reduce while a stop rests, and the emergency close order

Fix partial fills: exit legs must track the filled quantity and the take-profit must never open a position (the top-severity audit finding, for entries above 10 USD). Blocks risk sizing in Live. A reduce-only take-profit is ruled out (testnet: it leaves the position with no stop), and testnet could not produce a partial fill.

Post-experiment protection batch: emergency reduce-before-cancel, dead stop-leg branch, position-level loss cap, quote-silence watchdog, stop-side check at fill, stand-down cancels the entry, bounded freshness window
Remaining audit rows: trailing trigger offset, close during a socket gap, tick rounding direction, payload reader share mode, small log and feedback items
Remaining hygiene rows need runtime observation or a spec of their own; not clearable by a seat alone
